hooks: Chrome patched a zero-day that attackers are already exploiting.
BleepingComputer counts this as the eighth Chrome zero-day exploited this year.
what_happened: Google released emergency updates fixing a Use‑After‑Free bug in Chrome’s XML parser that attackers were exploiting in the wild.
why_it_matters: The fix covers Windows, macOS and Linux. Attackers can exploit this high-severity flaw to run malicious code.
the_catch: Google says the update may take days or weeks to reach all Chrome users.
